_metadata.description: Requirement stubs scaffolded from the P1 operational targets.

requirements.description: Drive iOS simulators on a macOS node through simctl and XCUITest: install, launch, input, semantic tree, screenshot and video capture.
requirements.title: ios-simctl strategy

validation.notes: integration phase — planned test `api/strategy/iossimctl/adapter_test.go::TestSimctlStrategyCapabilityTier`. Simulator adapter reports the semantic tier and satisfies install, launch, input, tree, screenshot and video against a fake simctl transport.

requirements.description: Drive physical iPhones through devicectl and WebDriverAgent at semantic tier. Gated on Apple Developer Program enrollment and code signing; reports unavailable with that next action until enrollment exists.
requirements.title: ios-xcuitest strategy

validation.notes: integration phase — planned test `api/strategy/iosxcuitest/adapter_test.go::TestXcuitestUnavailableWithoutSigning`. Without enrollment and signing the strategy reports unavailable naming that next action; with a fake signed environment it reports the semantic tier.

requirements.description: Drive physical iPhones through iPhone Mirroring with synthetic HID events and OCR. Floor tier only and requires no developer account, which makes it the first usable physical-iPhone path. Explicitly non-promotable for release evidence because OCR reads pixels rather than meaning.
requirements.title: ios-mirror strategy

validation.notes: Declaration seam is proven on Linux: every iOS strategy exposes evidence_class and ios-mirror is advisory-ocr/non-promotable. Full macOS mirroring remains intentionally unimplemented.

requirements.description: Drive the local machine as a device, reusing existing headless display and input tooling so desktop automation composes with the same flow vocabulary.
requirements.title: host-desktop strategy

validation.notes: Targeted suite proves the platform-neutral host-desktop declaration and the explicit unsupported Windows path while preserving the Linux prerequisite probe.

requirements.description: `device-control agent run --device <id> --goal "<goal>"` spawns an agent-manager run driven by a prompt-manager skill that teaches the CLI. Runs are bounded by step count, cost ceiling and lease scope, fully audited, and abortable.
requirements.title: Agent mode via agent-manager and a prompt-manager skill

validation.notes: integration phase — planned test `api/agent/run_test.go::TestAgentRunIsBoundedAuditedAndAbortable`. Agent run honours step, cost and lease bounds, records every action, and aborts cleanly; spawns through agent-manager with the prompt-manager skill.

requirements.description: Every agent action is recorded as a flow step, so a successful goal-directed run exports as a deterministic flow that replays without inference cost. This is the compounding loop: infer once, replay free.
requirements.title: Promote an agent run to a deterministic flow

validation.notes: unit phase — planned test `api/agent/promote_test.go::TestAgentRunExportsAsDeterministicFlow`. A completed agent run exports to a flow whose replay produces the same step sequence with no AI step remaining.

requirements.description: A flow step attaches to an application WebView and hands control to a named BAS flow, so native shell automation and web content automation compose on a single timeline with one evidence record.
requirements.title: Browser-automation-studio delegation step

validation.notes: integration phase — planned test `api/flows/basdelegation_test.go::TestWebViewDelegationSharesOneTimeline`. A delegation step attaches to a WebView, runs a named BAS flow, and merges its result into the same chaptered evidence timeline.

requirements.description: Live device view with session controls, flow authoring and validation, run review with chaptered evidence, and a strategy conformance matrix showing what each device can actually prove right now.
requirements.title: Operator UI

validation.notes: bas phase — planned test `bas/cases/02-operator/live-session-and-flow-review.json`. Operator surfaces: fleet view with per-device probed capability, live session with visible lease and kill, flow authoring validation, and run review with chaptered evidence. The zero-device onboarding slice is covered by `bas/cases/02-operator/onboarding-empty-state.json` and remains pending a detached-phone BAS run.

requirements.description: Captured reference images with stable identity so common targets resolve deterministically at the middle rung of the ladder, without inference cost and without a semantic tree.
requirements.title: Visual-anchor library

validation.notes: unit phase — planned test `api/flows/anchors_test.go::TestVisualAnchorResolvesWithoutInference`. A stored anchor resolves its target deterministically with no ai-gateway call recorded.

requirements.description: Typed normalized gesture vocabulary covers long press, double tap, drag, fling, scroll-to, and capability-gated pinch; pixel escape hatches are explicitly non-portable.
requirements.title: Typed gesture vocabulary

validation.notes: Targeted fake-runner table covers long press, double tap, drag, and fling; physical gesture proof remains pending.

requirements.description: Live Android state reads expose foreground, screen/lock, four-way orientation, battery, thermal, and display metrics with exact unavailable probe commands, and locked/off visible surfaces fail before capture.
requirements.title: Device state observation

validation.notes: Recorded dumpsys table covers all state fields; live phone was observed dozing and was not claimed as a screenshot gate.

requirements.description: Lease-owned state changes carry reverse-order undo callbacks and emit named restored or failed restoration events when a flow ends or is killed.
requirements.title: Guaranteed state restoration

validation.notes: State manager ordering and failure reporting are proven; kill-mid-flow hardware proof remains pending.

requirements.description: Vision results can promote persistent normalized anchors and completed runs can export deterministic replay flows with resolution rung metadata and failed-step exclusions.
requirements.title: Record and export replay flows

validation.notes: Vision-to-anchor replay asserts the second resolution makes no gateway call; physical export replay remains pending.

requirements.description: Bridge closes the out-of-band device-control dispatch path: device-scoped verbs require a matching, unexpired bridge-held lease record and every refusal is audited before run creation.
requirements.title: Bridge device lease dispatch gate

validation.notes: Targeted bridge service test proves failed-precondition refusal, no run/push side effects, and a rejected audit record; the held-record acceptance path is covered beside it.
